name: agent-steps
title: Agent steps
description: Shows the steps an AI agent is working through — done, running, waiting or failed — with a count in the header and rows that open to show what happened.
docs: Shows the steps an AI agent is working through — done, running, waiting or failed — with a count in the header and rows that open to show what happened. Do: Leave the ticks and the spinner in moss; the AI mark in the header already says an agent is working. Don't: Paint progress with the AI gradient — the gradient marks AI, moss marks progress. Do: Let finished steps go muted so the running step stands out. Don't: Strike finished steps through — long labels become hard to read. Do: Put what a step found in its detail, opened by pressing the row. Don't: Print every step's detail in the list — the list has to stay scannable. Use ai-thinking when the AI is only thinking before one answer; there are no separate steps to follow. Use progress when you know a percentage and there is nothing to read step by step. Use wizard when the person, not the AI, moves through the steps.
